business.about: Dixon Technologies (India) Limited,  incorporated  in  1993 ,  is  a  Electronic  Manufacturing  Services  (EMS)  company  with operations in the electronic products vertical such as consumer electronics, lighting, home appliance, closed-circuit television cameras  (CCTVs), and mobile  phones. It also  undertakes reverse logistics operations.  Besides, it manufactures security surveillance equipment, wearables & audibles, AC-PCBs. Recently, it has entered a JV with Imagine Marketing Private Limited for designing and manufacturing wireless audio solutions in India. [1]
business.in_their_words: Our mobile manufacturing business continues to be a key pillar of Dixon's growth strategy, and we Dixon Technologies (India) Limited October 30, 2026 remain focused on scaling volumes, strengthening operational efficiencies, and deepening our relationship with leading global and Indian customers. MPMS, that is Mobile Phone Manufacturing Scheme of the Government of India, presents a significant opportunity for Dixon to accelerate growth by scaling volumes and actively engaging with existing Indian brands to build long-term manufacturing partnerships to drive incremental volumes, strengthen market position, and capture a large share of India's mobile manufacturing opportunities. We are also exploring the opportunities to expand the partnership beyond mobile phones into adjacent product categories, creating avenues for business diversification and incremental growth. results.read: Revenue +47% YoY; EBITDA margin compressed 104 bps YoY to 3% — the lowest in 9 quarters; PAT -45% — sales growth didn't reach the bottom line.

calls: Growth is accelerating: revenue CAGR 58.9% over 3y vs 49.9% over 5y
Operating leverage: PAT compounding faster (86.1%) than revenue (58.9%)
Heavy capex under way: CWIP is 21% of fixed assets
Strong cash conversion: 5-yr operating cash flow is 1.22× reported profit
